_notes: REAL rows captured from data.binance.vision on 2026-08-02 (public Binance archive of Binance's own data; keyless). Kept as fixtures so tests/test_vision.py runs with ZERO network. Each block records what it proves. See DESIGN-orderflow-terminal.md §3d.
_header_is_per_file_not_per_year: STRATEGY.md M7 said header presence 'differed by year'. It differs per FILE: 2021-01-01 HAS one, 2021-01-02 does NOT, 2022-08-10 does NOT, 2022-08-11 DOES, monthly 2020-01 does NOT, monthly 2026-07 DOES. A year cutoff would lose or invent exactly one row on scattered days out of 2,406, silently, and corrupt min(agg_trade_id) on those days. Hence the sniff.

futures_um_2021_01_01_with_header._proves: a real day WITH a header row

futures_um_2021_01_02_no_header._proves: the NEXT DAY of the same year has NO header row

futures_um_2026_08_01_with_header._proves: the modern layout, and the exact rows the overlap proof joined against the recorded day file (399,219 rows, 0 set difference both ways, 0 field mismatches)

spot_2026_08_01_REFUSED._proves: why spot is refused by the allowlist and by G3/G4b: 8 columns (extra is_best_match), capitalized True/False, and transact_time in MICROSECONDS (16 digits, since 2025-01-01) which read as ms lands in year ~58500. Different instrument, different aggTradeId space, so the exact-dedup argument does not hold.

checksum_2026_08_01._proves: the exact CHECKSUM line format: <64 hex><two spaces><canonical filename>

overlap_2026_08_01._proves: the load-bearing claim, measured twice independently on 2026-08-02 against data/ticks/2026-08-01.duckdb
overlap_2026_08_01._recorded_defect: the recorded side carries 971 duplicate (binancef,BTCUSDT,trade_id) rows (+68 coinbase) — a SEPARATE bug (trades has no unique constraint and the aggTrades dedup guard is in-memory only). The archive has zero duplicates. Recorded is compared through DISTINCT and the surplus is printed, never absorbed.

seam_2026_07_31_to_08_01._proves: ID continuity holds ACROSS a day boundary, so gap detection is by the venue's own counter rather than by a timestamp guess
